definitions.explanation: Vegetables valued primarily for their edible leaves, such as spinach, lettuce, cabbage, and komatsuna. A common category in Japanese cooking and grocery shopping.

examples.japanese: {葉物|はもの}{野菜|やさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なっている→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{葉物|はもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of leafy vegetables went up due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{葉物|はもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重宝|ちょうほう}→重宝：14415_chouhou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since leafy vegetables become scarce in winter, Chinese cabbage for hot pot is valued.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used together as {葉物|はもの}{野菜|やさい} (leafy vegetables). A practical grocery and cooking term. Leafy vegetables are particularly sensitive to weather conditions, so their prices fluctuate seasonally, making this a common topic in daily conversation and news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {葉物|はもの}{野菜|やさい} (leafy vegetables)
- {葉物|はもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{傷|いた}む→傷む：10061_itamu⟧ (leafy vegetables spoil)
- ⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な{葉物|はもの} (fresh leafy vegetables)

EXAMPLES OF LEAFY VEGETABLES:
- ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧ (spinach)
- ⟦{小松菜|こまつな}→小松菜：12520_komatsuna⟧ (komatsuna)
- ⟦レタス→レタス：05193_retasu⟧ (lettuce)
- ⟦{白菜|はくさい}→白菜：13606_hakusai⟧ (Chinese cabbage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{根菜|こんさい}→根菜：13142_konsai⟧: root vegetables — vegetables valued for their roots (carrots, radishes)
- ⟦{果菜|かさい}→果菜：23482_kasai⟧: fruit vegetables — vegetables that are actually fruits (tomatoes, peppers)
